Package imageproof

package imageproof
Simple-Image-Proof: a small teaching program that measures one PNG or JPEG image and points out areas that may be worth a closer look.

Flow

The steps run in this order. Analysis runs them and App shows the result.

Histogram -> Comparison -> Regions -> Noise / Edges -> CopyMove / FlatPatch
          -> LocalAnomaly -> TamperingAssessment -> App

Classes

  • LoadedImage: reads a PNG or JPEG file and finds its real format.
  • Histogram: gray values (round(0.299 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B)) and the normalized 256-bin histogram.
  • Comparison: total variation distance TVD = 0.5 * sum|p - q| between two histograms, from 0 to 1.
  • Regions: the grid of 64-pixel tiles, with a histogram and a neighbour variation value for each tile.
  • Noise: noise residual (pixel minus 3 x 3 local mean) and its variance per tile.
  • Edges: Sobel gradients and edge strength sqrt(gx^2 + gy^2), per tile and as a picture.
  • CopyMove: finds identical 16 x 16 blocks that moved by the same shift.
  • FlatPatch: finds solid-colour patches in an otherwise noisy image.
  • LocalAnomaly: flags tiles whose histogram and noise both stand out from their neighbours and whose edges do not explain it.
  • TamperingAssessment: combines the rules into one cautious outcome and the measured anomalous area.
  • Analysis: holds all measurements of one image and runs the steps.
  • App: the Swing window with background jobs, tile selection and Advanced details.
  • ImagePanel and HistogramPanel: the drawing panels.

Important

This package is for learning. It is not forensic proof. The anomalous-area percentage is a measured area. It is never a probability of forgery or editing. Normal photos can have unusual tiles, so a finding only means "look closer". "No notable indicators" does not prove that an image is original or authentic.

  • Class
    Description
    Analysis
    All measurements for one image, collected in one place.
    App
    Main window of the program.
    Comparison
    Total variation distance (TVD) between two normalized histograms.
    CopyMove
    Looks for copy-move candidates: two 16 x 16 blocks with exactly the same gray values.
    CopyMove.Match
    One candidate pair: the block at (x1, y1) has the same pixels as the block at (x2, y2).
    Edges
    Sobel edge diagnostic.
    FlatPatch
    Finds solid-colour patches (like a Paint fill) in an otherwise noisy image.
    Histogram
    Turns an image into gray values (0 to 255) and a 256-bin histogram.
    HistogramPanel
    Swing panel that draws a normalized 256-bin histogram as bars.
    ImagePanel
    Swing panel that shows an image scaled to fit, keeping its shape (empty bars at the sides).
    LoadedImage
    One image file read from disk: the pixels plus its real format (PNG or JPEG).
    LocalAnomaly
    Local anomaly rule for ONE image.
    Noise
    Noise diagnostic.
    Regions
    Splits the image into square tiles (64 x 64 pixels by default) and measures each tile.
    TamperingAssessment
    Final assessment of ONE image.
    TamperingAssessment.Outcome
    The three possible results of the assessment.
